<module id="serial2parallel">
    <description>Series-Parallel Conversion Circuit</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="din_serial">Serial input data.</input>
        <input id="din_valid">Validity signal for input data.</input>
        <output id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data (8 bits wide).</output>
        <output id="dout_valid">Validity signal for the output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <!-- Define parameter descriptions here if needed -->
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <!-- Sequential logic block for counter and output generation -->
        reg [3:0] cnt;
        reg [7:0] dout_parallel_reg;
        reg dout_valid_reg;
        
        // Counter to keep track of the number of serial inputs received
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 0;
            end else if (din_valid) begin
                cnt <= cnt + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Output generation based on the counter value
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                dout_parallel_reg <= 0;
                dout_valid_reg <= 0;
            end else if (din_valid && (cnt == 8)) begin
                dout_parallel_reg[cnt - 1] <= din_serial;
                dout_valid_reg <= 1;
            end else begin
                dout_valid_reg <= 0;
            end
        end
        
        // Assigning the register values to output ports
        assign dout_parallel = dout_parallel_reg;
        assign dout_valid = dout_valid_reg;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <!-- Behavioral description of the circuit -->
        <!-- Sequential logic block for counter and output generation -->
        reg [3:0] cnt;
        reg [7:0] dout_parallel_reg;
        reg dout_valid_reg;
        
        // Counter to keep track of the number of serial inputs received
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 0;
            end else if (din_valid) begin
                cnt <= cnt + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Output generation based on the counter value
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                dout_parallel_reg <= 0;
                dout_valid_reg <= 0;
            end else if (din_valid && (cnt == 8)) begin
                dout_parallel_reg[cnt - 1] <= din_serial;
                dout_valid_reg <= 1;
            end else begin
                dout_valid_reg <= 0;
            end
        end
        
        // Assigning the register values to output ports
        assign dout_parallel = dout_parallel_reg;
        assign dout_valid = dout_valid_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
